Time Blender Demo

Walk, jump and hit through the fifteen factory backgrounds. Walk off the left or right edge to move to the next room.

Keys: ← → or A D to walk, Space ↑ or W to jump, Q to hit with the staff, [ ] to change room. Click the game first so it can read your keys.

Animations

Standing still · 4 frames
Walking · 8 frames
Jumping · 6 frames
Hit with Q · 6 frames
